records.title: Eldritch-Footer Telemetry Integration in Pi-Sidebar Overlay
records.constraint: Eldritch-Footer Telemetry Integration in Pi-Sidebar Overlay: 1. Implemented 'detailed' preset in pi-sidebar with rich multi-section layout matching eldritch-footer telemetry. 2. Added live quota polling for Kimi Coding (weekly and 5h window) and Z.ai / GLM Coding Plan (5h window, weekly, search quota). 3. Added support for thinking level indicators with emojis (🧠, ⚡, etc.), token breakdown (↑/↓), cache read/write with hit percentage (📦/🎯), and context usage bars. 4. Documented the configuration flow: switch pi-sidebar to '/sidebar preset detailed --global' and set eldritch-footer to '/footer minimal --global' (or '/footer off --global').

records.title: Removal of Conflicting Alt+ Shortcuts in Favor of Standard Pi Keybindings
records.constraint: Removal of Conflicting Alt+ Shortcuts in Favor of Standard Pi Keybindings: Removed alt+left, alt+right, alt+up, and alt+down shortcut registrations to prevent hijacking tui.editor.cursorWordLeft/Right, app.message.dequeue, and app.models.reorder. Retained standard non-conflicting ctrl+shift+ shortcuts.

records.title: Minimal Preset — Narrow Braille Gauge Strip for pi-sidebar
records.constraint: Minimal Preset — Narrow Braille Gauge Strip for pi-sidebar: Added new `minimal` preset rendered as a narrow strip (8–12 columns, default 10 on switch): braille ring gauge (new `src/gauge.ts`, U+2800 dot grid, plain Euclidean distance since braille dots are screen-square) filling clockwise from 12 o'clock with colored percent line and cost; thinking-level emoji; worst-of-windows quota mini-bar (contextBar, 70/90% color thresholds); git dirty/clean dot with ahead/behind arrows; MCP/LSP readiness dots. Minimal mode suppresses the bottom Git dock, ZKRATKY hints, and branding sections. Width bounds lowered 16→8 (config.ts, index.ts, commands.ts); preset switch to minimal auto-shrinks width to 10, switching back restores 28. Complements footer: footer keeps full text telemetry, sidebar shows gauges only.
